summary: Verified core database search and query design principles including SQL injection prevention, strict page_size bounding, and operational tradeoffs of dedicated search engines.
evidence: SQL concatenation risks: SQL injection, cross-tenant data exfiltration bypassing WHERE tenant_id, and query plan cache thrashing
page_size ceiling necessity: prevention of Node.js event-loop blocking, OOM crashes from massive JSON payloads, and PostgreSQL connection pool starvation
Search engine operational tradeoffs: dual-write index drift, eventual consistency lag breaking read-your-own-writes, and cluster maintenance/JVM overhead
